subtopics.label: Ambulatory Care Coordination and Fragmentation
subtopics.description: Research examining how fragmented ambulatory care delivery affects patient outcomes including hospitalization, emergency department visits, stroke, and cardiovascular events, as well as studies measuring care coordination gaps and their association with preventable adverse events across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: How gaps in ambulatory care coordination drive hospitalizations, ED visits, and preventable adverse events across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Telemedicine, Telehealth, and Digital Health Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies on the implementation, effectiveness, utilization patterns, and patient/provider experiences with telemedicine and digital health tools in primary and ambulatory care settings, including direct-to-consumer telehealth, video visits, remote patient monitoring, and telehealth disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Implementation, effectiveness, and equity of telemedicine, video visits, and remote monitoring in ambulatory care settings.

subtopics.label: Family Caregiver Assessment, Support, and Needs in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research focused on identifying, assessing, and addressing the needs of family caregivers within primary care settings, including caregiver burden, self-efficacy, preparedness, distress, and interventions to support caregivers of older adults and persons with dementia.
subtopics.short_description: Identifying and addressing caregiver burden, distress, and support needs for families of older adults and dementia patients.

subtopics.label: Chronic Disease Management: Diabetes and Multimorbidity
subtopics.description: Studies on diabetes prevention, self-management education, medication adherence, glycemic control, and co-management of diabetes with other chronic conditions including cancer, hypertension, and chronic pain in primary and ambulatory care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Diabetes prevention, self-management education, glycemic control, and co-management with hypertension, cancer, and chronic pain.

subtopics.label: Hypertension Management and Cardiovascular Disease Prevention
subtopics.description: Research on blood pressure control, cardiovascular risk assessment and prediction, hypertension treatment strategies, and primary prevention of cardiovascular disease across diverse populations including low-income countries, rural communities, and high-risk groups.
subtopics.short_description: Blood pressure control, cardiovascular risk assessment, and primary prevention strategies across diverse and high-risk populations.

subtopics.label: Heart Failure Care Delivery and Management
subtopics.description: Studies examining heart failure management in primary and ambulatory care settings, including home health care, medication management, polypharmacy, guideline-directed therapy, care transitions, patient education, and outcomes such as readmission and mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Ambulatory heart failure care including medication management, care transitions, patient education, and readmission reduction.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use Disorder, Substance Use Treatment, and Harm Reduction in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research on the management of opioid use disorder and other substance use disorders in primary care settings, including buprenorphine treatment, stigma reduction, harm reduction approaches, prescribing patterns, and integration of addiction treatment into general medical practice.
subtopics.short_description: Buprenorphine treatment, stigma reduction, and integration of addiction care into general medical practice.

subtopics.label: Hepatitis C, HIV, and Infectious Disease Management in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Studies on the treatment and care of hepatitis C, HIV, and other infectious diseases in primary care and community settings, including low-threshold treatment models, rapid treatment initiation, provider roles, and barriers to care for people who inject drugs.
subtopics.short_description: Low-threshold treatment models and care delivery for hepatitis C, HIV, and infectious disease in community settings.

subtopics.label: Cancer Screening, Survivorship, and Primary Care Integration
subtopics.description: Research on cancer screening practices, survivorship care coordination, and the role of primary care in managing cancer survivors, including disparities in screening uptake, barriers to preventive care, and co-management of chronic conditions in cancer survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Screening disparities, survivorship coordination, and chronic disease co-management for cancer survivors in primary care.

subtopics.label: Physician Payment, Quality Measurement, and Practice Organization
subtopics.description: Studies examining physician payment models including MIPS and value-based care, quality measurement systems, practice organization, physician time use, and the relationship between payment structures and care quality or physician behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Value-based payment models, quality measurement systems, and their effects on care quality and physician behavior.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health and Health Disparities in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research investigating how social determinants of health, neighborhood conditions, race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic factors influence health outcomes, healthcare utilization, and quality of care in primary and ambulatory care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Influence of race, socioeconomic status, and neighborhood conditions on health outcomes and care quality in ambulatory settings.

subtopics.label: Depression, Mental Health Integration, and Behavioral Health in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Studies on screening, treatment, and management of depression and mental health conditions in primary care settings, including integration of behavioral health services, treatment adherence, late-life depression interventions, and mental health-physical health comorbidity.
subtopics.short_description: Screening, treatment, and integration of mental health services for depression and behavioral health conditions in primary care.

subtopics.label: Obesity Management and Weight Loss Interventions in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological and behavioral interventions for obesity management in primary care settings, including anti-obesity medications, telemedicine-based weight management, AI-assisted approaches, and weight loss outcomes in diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmacological, behavioral, and telehealth-based obesity interventions and weight loss outcomes in diverse patient populations.

subtopics.label: Nursing Home and Post-Acute Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies on the organization and quality of care in nursing homes and post-acute settings, including the role of clinicians who specialize in nursing home care (SNFists), care continuity, telehealth use in nursing homes, and outcomes for residents with dementia and other chronic conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Quality, continuity, and clinician roles in nursing home and post-acute settings for residents with dementia and chronic conditions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Management, Long COVID, and Pandemic-Era Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on outpatient COVID-19 treatment, post-acute sequelae (long COVID), pandemic-related changes in care delivery, and the impact of COVID-19 on chronic disease management and healthcare access in primary care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Outpatient COVID-19 treatment, post-acute sequelae, and pandemic-driven changes in chronic disease management and access.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Risk Prediction, Screening, and Prevention
subtopics.description: Research on tools, models, and strategies for predicting and preventing cardiovascular disease risk across diverse populations, including ASCVD risk equations, screening programs, and primary prevention interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Risk models, screening tools, and primary prevention strategies for cardiovascular disease across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular and Chronic Disease Care in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Studies examining the epidemiology, management, and health system delivery of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, hypertension, and other chronic conditions in low- and middle-income countries, particularly Haiti, Tanzania, and other resource-limited settings.
subtopics.display_name: Chronic Disease Care in Low-Income Countries
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology and health system delivery of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and hypertension in resource-limited settings.

subtopics.label: Smoking Cessation and Tobacco Use Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on smoking cessation interventions, medication prescribing patterns, and tobacco use treatment across clinical settings including post-stroke, mental illness, and pharmacist-led programs.
subtopics.short_description: Cessation interventions, prescribing patterns, and tobacco treatment programs across clinical and community settings.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pain Assessment and Management in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research on assessment tools, patient beliefs, treatment barriers, and management strategies for chronic and neuropathic pain across diverse patient populations including older adults and refugees.
subtopics.short_description: Assessment tools, patient beliefs, and treatment strategies for chronic and neuropathic pain in diverse ambulatory populations.

subtopics.label: Medication Adherence, Deprescribing, and Polypharmacy
subtopics.description: Studies examining medication nonadherence, barriers and facilitators to deprescribing, polypharmacy management, and the downstream healthcare utilization and spending consequences of medication-related issues.
subtopics.short_description: Nonadherence barriers, polypharmacy management, and healthcare utilization consequences of medication-related issues.

subtopics.label: High-Cost Patients, Preventable Utilization, and Healthcare Spending
subtopics.description: Research identifying high-cost Medicare patients, patterns of preventable healthcare utilization and spending, and strategies to reduce unnecessary care through patient taxonomy and risk stratification.
subtopics.short_description: Identifying high-cost Medicare patients and reducing unnecessary spending through risk stratification and patient taxonomy.

subtopics.label: Genetic Testing, Hereditary Cancer Risk, and Lynch Syndrome
subtopics.description: Research on cascade genetic testing, hereditary colorectal and other cancer risk assessment, Lynch syndrome identification, and digital tools for genetic cancer risk evaluation in diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Cascade genetic testing, Lynch syndrome identification, and digital tools for hereditary cancer risk assessment.

subtopics.label: Patient Trust, Clinician-Patient Relationship, and Communication
subtopics.description: Studies examining the determinants of patient trust in clinicians, the role of compassion and communication in care quality, and organizational factors that support or undermine therapeutic relationships.
subtopics.short_description: Determinants of patient trust, compassion, and organizational factors shaping therapeutic clinician-patient relationships.

subtopics.label: Medical Education, Residency Training, and Clinical Competency
subtopics.description: Research on graduate medical education including residency training environments, curriculum gaps, competency development in behavioral health, nutrition, referrals, and career preferences among trainees.
subtopics.short_description: Graduate medical education, curriculum gaps, competency development, and career preferences among clinical trainees.

subtopics.label: Care Transitions, Hospital Discharge, and Readmission Prevention
subtopics.description: Studies on improving transitions from hospital to home or post-acute settings, including discharge planning interventions, medication barriers at discharge, readmission reduction strategies, and navigator programs.
subtopics.short_description: Discharge planning interventions, medication barriers, navigator programs, and strategies to reduce preventable hospital readmissions.

subtopics.label: Palliative Care, Advance Care Planning, and End-of-Life Needs
subtopics.description: Research on palliative care delivery, unmet palliative care needs, advance care planning, and depression screening in palliative settings, particularly among older adults and those with cognitive impairment.
subtopics.short_description: Palliative care delivery, unmet needs, and advance care planning for older adults and those with cognitive impairment.

subtopics.label: Vaccine Hesitancy, Uptake, and Communication Strategies
subtopics.description: Studies examining COVID-19 and other vaccine hesitancy, factors influencing vaccine acceptance, physician communication strategies, and community outreach interventions to improve vaccination rates.
subtopics.short_description: Factors influencing vaccine acceptance, physician communication strategies, and community outreach to improve vaccination rates.

subtopics.label: Liver Disease: NAFLD, MASH, Alcohol-Related Liver Disease, and Cirrhosis
subtopics.description: Research on identification, risk stratification, and management of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, metabolic-associated steatohepatitis, alcohol-related liver disease, and cirrhosis in primary and specialty care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Risk stratification and management of NAFLD, metabolic steatohepatitis, alcohol-related liver disease, and cirrhosis.

subtopics.label: Community Health Workers and Lay Health Worker Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating community health worker and lay health worker programs for chronic disease management, including diabetes, hypertension, and rheumatic conditions, across diverse and underserved populations.
subtopics.short_description: Lay health worker interventions for diabetes, hypertension, and chronic disease management in underserved populations.

subtopics.label: Elder Abuse, Mistreatment Screening, and Caregiver Neglect
subtopics.description: Research on screening for elder abuse and mistreatment in healthcare settings, including caregiver neglect identification, healthcare utilization patterns among abuse victims, and system-level screening approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Healthcare-based screening for elder abuse, caregiver neglect, and utilization patterns among mistreatment victims.
